title.en: Table of Meritorious Officials of Jing, Wu, Zhao, Xuan, Yuan, and Cheng

sentences.zh: 昔書稱「蠻夷帥服」，《詩》云「徐方既來」，春秋列潞子之爵，許其慕諸夏也。

translations.literal: Formerly the Book says "the barbarians lead in submission," the Odes say "Xu Fang has come," the Spring and Autumn records the rank of the Son of Lu, acknowledging their desire to emulate the Central States.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Book of Documents says, "The barbarians lead in submission," the Odes say, "Xu Fang has come," and the Spring and Autumn Annals records the rank of the Son of Lu, acknowledging their desire to emulate the Central States.

sentences.zh: 漢興至于孝文時，乃有弓高、襄城之封，雖自外來，本功臣後。

translations.literal: Han rose until Emperor Wen's time, then there were the enfeoffments of Gonggao and Xiangcheng; though they came from outside, they were originally descendants of meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: From the rise of Han until the time of Emperor Wen, there were the enfeoffments of Gonggao and Xiangcheng; though they came from outside, they were originally descendants of meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 故至孝景始欲侯降者，丞相周亞夫守約而爭。

translations.literal: Therefore when Emperor Jing first wished to enfeoff those who surrendered, Chancellor Zhou Yafu upheld the covenant and objected.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, when Emperor Jing first wished to enfeoff those who surrendered, Chancellor Zhou Yafu upheld the covenant and objected.

sentences.zh: 帝黜其議，初開封賞之科，又有吳楚之事。

translations.literal: Emperor rejected his counsel, initially opened enfeoffment reward regulations, moreover had Wu Chu affair.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rejected his counsel and initially opened up the regulations for enfeoffment rewards. Moreover, there was the Wu and Chu affair.

sentences.zh: 武興胡越之伐，將帥受爵，應本約矣。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Wu the campaigns against the Hu and Yue were raised; generals and commanders received titles, answering to the original covenant.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wu the campaigns against the Hu and Yue were raised, and generals and commanders received titles in accord with the original covenant.

sentences.zh: 後有承平，頗有勞臣，輯而序之，續元功次云。

translations.literal: Later in the era of sustained peace there were many meritorious ministers; they were compiled and arranged in order, continuing the ranking of highest merit, as follows.

cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed in the eleventh month of the second year

cells.content: 六年，侯仁嗣，永光四年，坐使家丞上書還印符，隨方士，免。
cells.literal: After six years, Marquis Ren succeeded. In the fourth year of Yongguang, he was convicted of ordering his household steward to submit a memorial returning his seal and credentials in order to follow a fangshi adept; he was dismissed
cells.idiomatic: Six years later, Marquis Ren inherited the title. In Yongguang 4, he was dismissed for ordering his household steward to submit a memorial returning his seal and credentials so he could follow a fangshi adept

cells.content: 清河
cells.literal: Qinghe
cells.idiomatic: Qinghe

cells.content: 當塗康侯魏不害
cells.literal: Marquis Kang of Dangtu: Wei Buhai
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Kang of Dangtu: Wei Buhai

cells.content: 以圉守尉捕反者淮陽胡倩侯，侯聖與議定策，益封，凡二千二百戶。
cells.literal: As a garrison commandant's guard, he captured the rebel Hu Qian of Huaiyang; Marquis Sheng participated in the deliberations to establish the succession and received additional enfeoffment, totaling 2,200 households
cells.idiomatic: As a garrison commandant's guard, he captured the rebel Hu Qian of Huaiyang. Marquis Sheng later participated in the succession deliberations and received additional enfeoffment, bringing the total to 2,200 households

cells.content: 十一月封，薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed in the eleventh month; he died
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed in the eleventh month. He died

cells.content: 愛侯聖嗣。
cells.literal: Marquis Ai, Sheng, succeeded to the title
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ai — Sheng — inherited the title

cells.content: 剌侯楊嗣。
cells.literal: Marquis La, Yang, succeeded to the title
cells.idiomatic: Marquis La — Yang — inherited the title

cells.content: 戴侯向嗣。
cells.literal: Marquis Dai, Xiang, succeeded to the title
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Dai — Xiang — inherited the title

cells.content: 九江侯堅居嗣，居攝二年，更為翼漢侯，王莽篡位，為翼新侯，莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Marquis of Jiujiang, Jian Ju, succeeded. In the second year of Jushe, his title was changed to Marquis of Yihan. When Wang Mang usurped the throne, it became Marquis of Yixin. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: Jian Ju inherited the title as Marquis of Jiujiang. In Jushe 2, his title was changed to Marquis of Yihan. Under Wang Mang's usurpation, it became Marquis of Yixin. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 蒲侯蘇昌
cells.literal: Marquis of Pu: Su Chang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Pu: Su Chang

cells.content: 以圉小史捕反者故越王子鄒起侯，千二十六戶。
cells.literal: As a minor clerk of the stables, he captured the rebel Zou Qi, son of the former King of Yue; made marquis with a fief of 1,026 households
cells.idiomatic: A minor clerk of the stables who captured the rebel Zou Qi, son of the former King of Yue. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,026 households

cells.content: 十一月封。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed in the eleventh month
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed in the eleventh month

cells.content: 侯夷吾嗣，鴻嘉三年，坐婢自贖為民後略以為婢，免。
cells.literal: Marquis Yiwu day succeeded. In the third year of Hongjia, he was convicted of allowing a maidservant to redeem herself and become a commoner, then abducting her back into servitude; he was dismissed
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Yiwu day inherited the title. In Hongjia 3, he was dismissed for allowing a maidservant to redeem herself as a commoner, then abducting her back into servitude

cells.content: 琅邪
cells.literal: Lang Ye
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Lang Ye

cells.content: 丞父侯孫王
cells.literal: Marquis of Chengfu: Sun Wang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Chengfu: Sun Wang

cells.content: 以告反者太原白義等侯，千一百五十戶。
cells.literal: He informed on the rebel Bai Yi of Taiyuan and others; made marquis with a fief of 1,150 households
cells.idiomatic: He reported the rebels Bai Yi of Taiyuan and others. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,150 households

cells.content: 四年三月乙酉封，三年，始元元年，坐殺人，會赦，免。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a yiyou day in the third month of the fourth year. After three years, in the first year of Shiyuan, he was convicted of murder but pardoned under a general amnesty; he was dismissed
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a yiyou day in the third month of the fourth year. Three years later, in Shiyuan 1, he was convicted of murder. He was pardoned under a general amnesty but dismissed

cells.content: 東萊
cells.literal: Donglai
cells.idiomatic: Donglai

translations.literal: Above: seventy-five persons under Emperor Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists seventy-five persons enfeoffed under Emperor Wu.

sentences.zh: 武安、周陽、長平、冠軍、平津、周子南、樂通、牧丘、富民九人在外戚恩澤，南奅、龍額、宜春、陰安、發干五人隨父，凡八十九人，王子不在其中。

translations.literal: Wu'an, Zhouyang, Changping, Guanjun, Pingjin, Zhou Zinan, Letong, Muqiu, and Fumin — nine persons counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. Nanqiao, Long'e, Yichun, Yin'an, and Fagan — five persons listed with their fathers. In total, eighty-nine persons; royal princes are not included among them.
translations.idiomatic: Nine persons — Wu'an, Zhouyang, Changping, Guanjun, Pingjin, Zhou Zinan, Letong, Muqiu, and Fumin — are counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. Five — Nanqiao, Long'e, Yichun, Yin'an, and Fagan — are listed with their fathers. The total is eighty-nine persons; royal princes are not included.

cells.content: 秺敬侯金日磾
cells.literal: Marquis Jing of Du: Jin Midi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Du: Jin Midi

cells.content: 以駙馬都尉發覺侍中莽何羅反侯，二千二百一十八戶。
cells.literal: As Commandant of the Consort's Cavalry, he uncovered the rebellion of Attendant-in-Ordinary Mang Heluo; made marquis with a fief of 2,218 households
cells.idiomatic: As Commandant of the Consort's Cavalry, he uncovered the rebellion of the Attendant-in-Ordinary Mang Heluo. He was made marquis with a fief of 2,218 households

cells.content: 始元二年侯，丙子封，一日薨。
cells.literal: Made marquis in the second year of Shiyuan, enfeoffed on a bingzi day; he died one day later
cells.idiomatic: Made marquis in Shiyuan 2 and enfeoffed on a bingzi day. He died just one day later

cells.content: 始元二年，侯賞嗣，四十二年薨，亡後。
cells.literal: In the second year of Shiyuan, Marquis Shang succeeded. After forty-two years he died, leaving no heir
cells.idiomatic: In Shiyuan 2, Marquis Shang inherited the title. He died forty-two years later, leaving no heir

cells.content: 孫
cells.literal: Grandson
cells.idiomatic: Grandson

cells.content: 元始四年，侯常以日磾曾孫紹侯，千戶，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanshi, Marquis Chang, as a great-grandson of Jin Midi, continued the marquessate with a fief of 1,000 households. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 4, Chang continued the marquessate as a great-grandson of Jin Midi, with a fief of 1,000 households. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 建平敬侯杜延年
cells.literal: Marquis Jing of Jianping: Du Yannian
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Jianping: Du Yannian

cells.content: 以諫大夫告左將軍等反侯，二千戶，以太僕與大將軍先定策，益封，二千三百六十戶。
cells.literal: As a Remonstrant Grandee, he reported the rebellion of the Left General and others; made marquis with a fief of 2,000 households. As Grand Coachman, he participated with the Grand General in establishing the succession, and received additional enfeoffment, totaling 2,360 households
cells.idiomatic: As a Remonstrant Grandee, he reported the rebellion of the Left General and others, receiving a fief of 2,000 households. Later, as Grand Coachman, he joined the Grand General in establishing the succession and received an additional grant, bringing the total to 2,360 households

cells.content: 元鳳元年七月甲子封，二十八年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month of the first year of Yuanfeng. After twenty-eight years he died
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month of the first year of Yuanfeng. He died twenty-eight years later

cells.content: 甘露二年，孝侯緩嗣，十九年薨。
cells.literal: In Ganlu 2, Marquis Xiao, Huan, succeeded; he died nineteen years later
cells.idiomatic: In Ganlu 2, Marquis Xiao — Huan — inherited the title. He died nineteen years later

cells.content: 竟寧元年，荒侯業嗣，三十四年薨。
cells.literal: In Jingning 1, Marquis Huang, Ye, succeeded; he died thirty-four years later
cells.idiomatic: In Jingning 1, Marquis Huang — Ye — inherited the title. He died thirty-four years later

cells.content: 元始二年，侯輔嗣。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 2, Marquis Fu succeeded
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 2, Marquis Fu inherited the title

cells.content: 濟陽侯憲嗣，建武中以先降梁王，薨，不得代。
cells.literal: Marquis Xian of Jiyang succeeded. During the Jianwu era, because he had previously surrendered to the King of Liang, when he died his line was not permitted to continue
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Xian of Jiyang inherited the title. During the Jianwu era, because he had previously surrendered to the King of Liang, his line was not permitted to continue when he died

cells.content: 宜城戴侯燕倉
cells.literal: Marquis Dai of Yicheng: Yan Cang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Dai of Yicheng: Yan Cang

cells.content: 以假稻田使者先發覺左將軍桀等反謀，告大司農敞，侯。侯安削戶六百，定七百戶。
cells.literal: As acting envoy for the rice fields, he was the first to discover the Left General Jie's plot of rebellion and reported it to the Grand Minister of Agriculture, Chang; made marquis. Marquis An had 600 households deducted, fixing the fief at 700 households
cells.idiomatic: As acting rice-field envoy, he was the first to uncover the Left General Jie's rebellion plot and reported it to the Grand Minister of Agriculture. He was made marquis. Later, Marquis An had 600 households deducted, fixing the fief at 700

cells.content: 七月甲子封，六年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month; he died six years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month. He died six years later

cells.content: 元平元年，刺侯安嗣，四十一年薨。
cells.literal: In Yuanping 1, Marquis Ci, An, succeeded; he died forty-one years later
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanping 1, Marquis Ci — An — inherited the title. He died forty-one years later

cells.content: 竟寧元年，釐侯尊嗣，十年薨。
cells.literal: In Jingning 1, Marquis Xi, Zun, succeeded; he died ten years later
cells.idiomatic: In Jingning 1, Marquis Xi — Zun — inherited the title. He died ten years later

cells.content: 陽朔二年，煬侯武嗣。
cells.literal: In Yangshuo 2, Marquis Yang, Wu, succeeded
cells.idiomatic: In Yangshuo 2, Marquis Yang — Wu — inherited the title

cells.content: 濟陰侯級嗣。
cells.literal: Marquis Ji of Jiyin succeeded
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ji of Jiyin inherited the title

cells.content: 六世侯舊嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Generation entry: 六世侯舊嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.idiomatic: Generation entry: 六世侯舊嗣，王莽敗，絕。

cells.content: 弋陽節侯任宮
cells.literal: Marquis Jie of Yiyang: Ren Gong
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie of Yiyang: Ren Gong

cells.content: 以故丞相徵事手捕反者左將軍桀，侯，九百一十五戶。
cells.literal: As a former summons officer of the Chancellor, he personally captured the rebel Left General Jie; made marquis with a fief of 915 households
cells.idiomatic: A former summons officer of the Chancellor who personally captured the rebel Left General Jie. He was made marquis with a fief of 915 households

cells.content: 七月甲子封，三十三年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month; he died thirty-three years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month. He died thirty-three years later

cells.content: 初元二年，剛侯千秋嗣，三十二年薨。
cells.literal: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Gang, Qianqiu, succeeded; he died thirty-two years later
cells.idiomatic: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Gang — Qianqiu — inherited the title. He died thirty-two years later

cells.content: 河平三年，愿侯惲嗣，二年薨。
cells.literal: In Heping 3, Marquis Yuan, Yun, succeeded; he died two years later
cells.idiomatic: In Heping 3, Marquis Yuan — Yun — inherited the title. He died two years later

cells.content: 陽朔元年，孝侯岑嗣，二十四年薨。
cells.literal: In Yangshuo 1, Marquis Xiao, Cen, succeeded; he died twenty-four years later
cells.idiomatic: In Yangshuo 1, Marquis Xiao — Cen — inherited the title. He died twenty-four years later

cells.content: 元始元年，侯固嗣，更始元年，為兵所殺。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 1, Marquis Gu succeeded. In Gengshi 1, he was killed by soldiers
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 1, Marquis Gu inherited the title. In Gengshi 1, he was killed by soldiers

cells.content: 商利侯王山壽
cells.literal: Marquis of Shangli: Wang Shanshou
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Shangli: Wang Shanshou

cells.content: 以丞相少史誘反者車騎將軍安入丞相府，侯，九百一十五戶。
cells.literal: As a junior clerk of the Chancellor, he lured the rebel General of Chariots and Cavalry, An, into the Chancellor's office; made marquis with a fief of 915 households
cells.idiomatic: A junior clerk of the Chancellor who lured the rebel General of Chariots and Cavalry into the Chancellor's office. He was made marquis with a fief of 915 households

cells.content: 七月甲子封，十四年，元康元年，坐為代郡太守故劾十人罪不直，免。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month. After fourteen years, in Yuankang 1, he was convicted of having unjustly indicted ten people while serving as Governor of Dai Commandery; he was dismissed
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the seventh month. Fourteen years later, in Yuankang 1, he was dismissed for unjustly indicting ten people while serving as Governor of Dai Commandery

cells.content: 徐
cells.literal: Xu
cells.idiomatic: Xu

cells.content: 成安嚴侯郭忠
cells.literal: Marquis Yan of Cheng'an: Guo Zhong
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Yan of Cheng'an: Guo Zhong

cells.content: 以張掖屬國都尉匈奴入寇與戰，斬黎汗王，侯，七百二十四戶。
cells.literal: As Commandant of the Dependent State of Zhangye, when the Xiongnu invaded he fought them, beheading the Lihan King; made marquis with a fief of 724 households
cells.idiomatic: As Commandant of the Zhangye Dependent State, he fought the invading Xiongnu and beheaded their Lihan King. He was made marquis with a fief of 724 households

cells.content: 三年二月癸丑封，七年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a guichou day in the second month of the third year; he died seven years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a guichou day in the second month of the third year. He died seven years later

cells.content: 本始三年，愛侯遷嗣，四年薨。
cells.literal: In Benshi 3, Marquis Ai, Qian, succeeded; he died four years later
cells.idiomatic: In Benshi 3, Marquis Ai — Qian — inherited the title. He died four years later

cells.content: 元康三年，刻侯賞嗣，四十一年薨。
cells.literal: In Yuankang 3, Marquis Ke, Shang, succeeded; he died forty-one years later
cells.idiomatic: In Yuankang 3, Marquis Ke — Shang — inherited the title. He died forty-one years later

cells.content: 陽朔三年，𨜐侯長嗣。
cells.literal: In Yangshuo 3, Marquis Xi, Chang, succeeded
cells.idiomatic: In Yangshuo 3, Marquis Xi — Chang — inherited the title

cells.content: 潁川釐侯萌嗣，薨，亡後。
cells.literal: Marquis Xi of Yingchuan, Meng, succeeded; he died and left no heir
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Xi of Yingchuan — Meng — inherited the title. He died and left no heir

cells.content: 六世居攝元年，侯每以忠玄孫之子紹封，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: In the first year of Juzshe of the sixth generation, Marquis Mei continued the enfeoffment as a descendant of Zhong's great-grandson. When Wang Mang fell, the line ended
cells.idiomatic: In the first year of Juzshe of the sixth generation, Marquis Mei continued the enfeoffment as a descendant of Zhong's great-grandson. When Wang Mang fell, the line ended

cells.content: 平陵侯范明友
cells.literal: Marquis of Pingling: Fan Mingyou
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Pingling: Fan Mingyou

cells.content: 以校尉擊反氐，後以將軍擊烏桓，獲王，虜首六千二百，侯，與大將軍光定策，益封，凡二千九百二十戶，
cells.literal: As a Colonel he attacked the rebellious Di; later as a General he attacked the Wuhuan, captured the king, and took 6,200 heads. Made marquis; he participated with Grand General Guang in establishing the succession and received additional enfeoffment, totaling 2,920 households
cells.idiomatic: As a Colonel he attacked the rebellious Di. Later, as a General, he attacked the Wuhuan, captured their king, and took 6,200 heads. Made marquis, he joined Grand General Huo Guang in establishing the succession and received additional enfeoffment, totaling 2,920 households

cells.content: 四年七月乙巳封，十一年，地節四年，坐謀反誅。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a yisi day in the seventh month of the fourth year. After eleven years, in Dijie 4, he was convicted of plotting rebellion and executed
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a yisi day in the seventh month of the fourth year. Eleven years later, in Dijie 4, he was convicted of plotting rebellion and put to death

cells.content: 武當
cells.literal: Wu Dang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Wu Dang

cells.content: 義陽侯傅介子
cells.literal: Marquis of Yiyang: Fu Jiezi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yiyang: Fu Jiezi

cells.content: 以平樂廄監使誅樓蘭王，斬首，侯，七百五十九戶。
cells.literal: As Supervisor of the Pingle Stables, he was sent to execute the King of Loulan, beheading him; made marquis with a fief of 759 households
cells.idiomatic: As Supervisor of the Pingle Stables, he was dispatched to assassinate the King of Loulan, beheading him. He was made marquis with a fief of 759 households

cells.content: 七月乙巳封，十三年，元康元年薨。嗣子有罪，不得代。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a yisi day in the seventh month; he died thirteen years later in Yuankang 1. His heir-designate was guilty of a crime and not permitted to succeed
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a yisi day in the seventh month. He died thirteen years later, in Yuankang 1. His heir was guilty of a crime and not permitted to succeed

cells.content: 元始四年，侯長以介子曾孫紹封，更始元年，為兵所殺。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 4, Marquis Chang, as a great-grandson of Fu Jiezi, continued the enfeoffment. In Gengshi 1, he was killed by soldiers
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 4, Chang continued the marquessate as a great-grandson of Fu Jiezi. In Gengshi 1, he was killed by soldiers

cells.content: 平氏
cells.literal: Ping Shi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Ping Shi

translations.literal: Above: eight persons under Emperor Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists eight persons enfeoffed under Emperor Zhao.

sentences.zh: 博陸、安陽、宜春、安平、富平、陽平六人在恩澤外戚，桑樂一人隨父，凡十五人。

translations.literal: Bolu, Anyang, Yichun, Anping, Fuping, and Yangping — six persons counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. Sangle — one person listed with his father. In total, fifteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Six persons — Bolu, Anyang, Yichun, Anping, Fuping, and Yangping — are counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. One — Sangle — is listed with his father. The total is fifteen persons.

cells.content: 長羅壯侯常惠
cells.literal: Marquis Zhuang of Changluo: Chang Hui
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Zhuang of Changluo: Chang Hui

cells.content: 以校尉光祿大夫持節將烏孫兵擊匈奴，獲名王，首虜三萬九千級，侯，二千八百五十戶。
cells.literal: As a Colonel and Grandee of the Glorious Emolument, he held the imperial credentials and led the Wusun troops to attack the Xiongnu, capturing a famous king and taking 39,000 heads and prisoners; made marquis with a fief of 2,850 households
cells.idiomatic: As a Colonel and Grandee of the Glorious Emolument, holding the imperial credentials, he led the Wusun forces to attack the Xiongnu. He captured a renowned king and took 39,000 heads and prisoners, receiving a fief of 2,850 households

cells.content: 本始四年四月癸巳封，二十四年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a guisi day in the fourth month of Benshi 4; he died twenty-four years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a guisi day in the fourth month of Benshi 4. He died twenty-four years later

cells.content: 初元二年，嚴侯成嗣，十六年薨。
cells.literal: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Yan, Cheng, succeeded; he died sixteen years later
cells.idiomatic: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Yan — Cheng — inherited the title. He died sixteen years later

cells.content: 建始三年，愛侯邯嗣，五年薨。
cells.literal: In Jianshi 3, Marquis Ai, Han, succeeded; he died five years later
cells.idiomatic: In Jianshi 3, Marquis Ai — Han — inherited the title. He died five years later

cells.content: 河平四年，侯翕嗣，四十九年，建武四年薨，亡後。
cells.literal: In Heping 4, Marquis Xi succeeded; after forty-nine years, he died in Jianwu 4, leaving no heir
cells.idiomatic: In Heping 4, Marquis Xi inherited the title. Forty-nine years later, he died in Jianwu 4, leaving no heir

cells.content: 陳留
cells.literal: Chenliu
cells.idiomatic: Chenliu

cells.content: 爰戚靖侯趙長年
cells.literal: Marquis Jing of Yuanqi: Zhao Changnian
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Yuanqi: Zhao Changnian

cells.content: 以平陵大夫告楚王延壽反，侯，千五百三十戶。
cells.literal: As a Grandee of Pingling, he reported the rebellion of King Yanshou of Chu; made marquis with a fief of 1,530 households
cells.idiomatic: A Grandee of Pingling who reported the rebellion of King Yanshou of Chu. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,530 households

cells.content: 地節二年四月癸卯封，十七年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a guimao day in the fourth month of Dijie 2; he died seventeen years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a guimao day in the fourth month of Dijie 2. He died seventeen years later

cells.content: 節侯訢嗣。
cells.literal: Marquis Jie, Xin, succeeded
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie — Xin — inherited the title

cells.content: 永始四年，侯牧嗣，四十年，建武四年，以先降梁王，免。
cells.literal: In Yongshi 4, Marquis Mu succeeded; after forty years, in Jianwu 4, because he had previously surrendered to the King of Liang, he was dismissed
cells.idiomatic: In Yongshi 4, Marquis Mu inherited the title. Forty years later, in Jianwu 4, he was dismissed for having previously surrendered to the King of Liang

cells.content: 博成侯張章
cells.literal: Marquis of Bocheng: Zhang Zhang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Bocheng: Zhang Zhang

cells.content: 以長安男子先發覺大司馬霍禹等謀反，以告期門董忠，忠以聞，侯，三千九百一十三戶。
cells.literal: As a commoner of Chang'an, he was the first to discover the plot of Grand Marshal Huo Yu and others to rebel, and reported it to Gate Guard Dong Zhong, who brought it to the emperor's attention; made marquis with a fief of 3,913 households
cells.idiomatic: A commoner of Chang'an who was the first to discover the rebellion plot of Grand Marshal Huo Yu and others. He reported it to Gate Guard Dong Zhong, who brought it to the emperor's attention. He was made marquis with a fief of 3,913 households

cells.content: 四年八月乙丑封，九年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month of the fourth year; he died nine years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month of the fourth year. He died nine years later

cells.content: 五鳳元年，侯建嗣，十二年，建始四年，坐尚陽邑公主與婢姦主旁，數醉罵主，免。
cells.literal: In Wufeng 1, Marquis Jian succeeded; after twelve years, in Jianshi 4, he was convicted of having married Princess Yangyi but committing adultery with a maidservant beside the princess, and of repeatedly getting drunk and cursing the princess; he was dismissed
cells.idiomatic: In Wufeng 1, Marquis Jian inherited the title. Twelve years later, in Jianshi 4, he was dismissed for committing adultery with a maidservant in the presence of his wife Princess Yangyi, and for repeatedly getting drunk and cursing the princess

cells.content: 淮陽
cells.literal: Huaiyang
cells.idiomatic: Huaiyang

cells.content: 高昌壯侯董忠
cells.literal: Marquis Zhuang of Gaochang: Dong Zhong
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Zhuang of Gaochang: Dong Zhong

cells.content: 以期門受張章言霍禹謀反，告左曹楊惲，侯，再坐法，削戶千一百，定七十九戶。
cells.literal: As a Gate Guard, he received Zhang Zhang's report that Huo Yu was plotting rebellion and forwarded it to Left Section Chief Yang Yun; made marquis. He was twice convicted of offenses and had 1,100 households deducted, fixing the fief at 79 households
cells.idiomatic: As a Gate Guard, he received Zhang Zhang's report of Huo Yu's rebellion plot and forwarded it to Yang Yun of the Left Section. He was made marquis but was twice convicted and had 1,100 households deducted, leaving a fief of just 79 households

cells.content: 八月乙丑封，十九年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month; he died nineteen years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month. He died nineteen years later

cells.content: 初元二年，煬侯宏嗣，四十一年，建平元年，坐佞邪，免，二年，復封故國，三年薨。
cells.literal: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Yang, Hong, succeeded; after forty-one years, in Jianping 1, he was convicted of sycophancy and dismissed. In the second year he was re-enfeoffed in his former domain; in the third year he died
cells.idiomatic: In Chuyuan 2, Marquis Yang — Hong — inherited the title. After forty-one years, in Jianping 1, he was dismissed for sycophantic behavior. He was re-enfeoffed in his former domain the next year and died the year after that

cells.content: 元壽元年，侯武嗣，二年，坐父宏前為佞邪，免。
cells.literal: In the first year of Yuanshou, Marquis Wu succeeded; in the second year, he was convicted on account of his father Hong's previous sycophancy and dismissed
cells.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanshou, Marquis Wu inherited the title. A year later, he was dismissed on account of his father Hong's earlier sycophantic conduct

cells.content: 建武二年五月己巳，侯永紹封。
cells.literal: On a jisi day in the fifth month of Jianwu 2, Marquis Yong continued the enfeoffment
cells.idiomatic: On a jisi day in the fifth month of Jianwu 2, Marquis Yong continued the marquessate

cells.content: 千乘
cells.literal: Qian Cheng
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Qian Cheng

cells.content: 平通侯楊惲
cells.literal: Marquis of Pingtong: Yang Yun
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Pingtong: Yang Yun

cells.content: 以左曹中郎受董忠等言霍禹等謀，以告侍中金安上，侯，二千五百戶。
cells.literal: As a Palace Gentleman of the Left Section, he received Dong Zhong's report of Huo Yu's plot and forwarded it to Attendant-in-Ordinary Jin Anshang; made marquis with a fief of 2,500 households
cells.idiomatic: As a Palace Gentleman of the Left Section, he received Dong Zhong's report of Huo Yu's plot and relayed it to Attendant-in-Ordinary Jin Anshang. He was made marquis with a fief of 2,500 households

cells.content: 八月乙丑封，十年，五鳳三年，坐為光祿勳誹謗政治，免。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month. After ten years, in Wufeng 3, he was convicted of slandering the government while serving as Superintendent of the Imperial Household; he was dismissed
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month. Ten years later, in Wufeng 3, he was dismissed for slandering the government while serving as Superintendent of the Imperial Household

cells.content: 博陽
cells.literal: Boyang
cells.idiomatic: Boyang

cells.content: 都成敬侯金安上
cells.literal: Marquis Jing of Ducheng: Jin Anshang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Ducheng: Jin Anshang

cells.content: 以侍中中郎將受楊惲言霍禹等反謀，傳言止內霍氏禁闥，侯，千七百七十一戶。
cells.literal: As Attendant-in-Ordinary and Commander of the Palace Gentlemen, he received Yang Yun's report of Huo Yu's rebellion plot and relayed the word to stop the Huo clan from entering the restricted gates of the inner palace; made marquis with a fief of 1,771 households
cells.idiomatic: As Attendant-in-Ordinary and Commander of the Palace Gentlemen, he received Yang Yun's report of the Huo clan's rebellion plot and relayed the order to bar the Huo family from the inner palace gates. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,771 households

cells.content: 八月乙丑封，十一年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month; he died eleven years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a yichou day in the eighth month. He died eleven years later

cells.content: 五鳳三年，夷侯常嗣，一年薨，亡後。
cells.literal: In Wufeng 3, Marquis Yi, Chang, succeeded; he died one year later, leaving no heir
cells.idiomatic: In Wufeng 3, Marquis Yi — Chang — inherited the title. He died a year later, leaving no heir

cells.content: 元始元年，侯欽以安上孫紹封，為王莽誅。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 1, Marquis Qin, as a grandson of Jin Anshang, continued the enfeoffment; he was executed by Wang Mang
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 1, Qin continued the marquessate as a grandson of Jin Anshang. He was executed by Wang Mang

cells.content: 元始元年，戴侯楊嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 1, Marquis Dai, Yang, succeeded. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 1, Marquis Dai — Yang — inherited the title. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 合陽愛侯梁喜
cells.literal: Marquis Ai of Heyang: Liang Xi
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ai of Heyang: Liang Xi

cells.content: 以平陽大夫告霍徵史、徵史子信、家監迴倫、故侍郎鄭尚時謀反，侯，千五百戶。
cells.literal: As a Grandee of Pingyang, he reported that Huo's summoner, the summoner's son Xin, household supervisor Hui Lun, and former Attendant Gentleman Zheng Shangshi were plotting rebellion; made marquis with a fief of 1,500 households
cells.idiomatic: A Grandee of Pingyang who reported that Huo's summoner, the summoner's son Xin, household supervisor Hui Lun, and the former Attendant Gentleman Zheng Shangshi were plotting rebellion. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,500 households

cells.content: 元康四年二月壬午封，四十一年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a renwu day in the second month of Yuankang 4; he died forty-one years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a renwu day in the second month of Yuankang 4. He died forty-one years later

cells.content: 建始二年，侯放嗣。
cells.literal: In Jianshi 2, Marquis Fang succeeded
cells.idiomatic: In Jianshi 2, Marquis Fang inherited the title

cells.content: 元始五年，侯萌以喜孫紹封，千戶，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 5, Marquis Meng, as a grandson of Liang Xi, continued the enfeoffment with a fief of 1,000 households. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 5, Meng continued the marquessate as a grandson of Liang Xi, with a fief of 1,000 households. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 平原
cells.literal: Ping Yuan
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Ping Yuan

cells.content: 安遠繆侯鄭吉
cells.literal: Marquis Miao of Anyuan: Zheng Ji
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Miao of Anyuan: Zheng Ji

cells.content: 以校尉光祿大年將兵迎日逐王降，又破車師，侯，坐法削戶三百，定七百九十戶。
cells.literal: As a Colonel and Senior Grandee of the Glorious Emolument, he led troops to receive the surrender of the Rizhu King and also defeated Cheshi; made marquis. He was convicted of a legal offense and had 300 households deducted, fixing the fief at 790 households
cells.idiomatic: As a Colonel and Senior Grandee of the Glorious Emolument, he led troops to receive the Rizhu King's surrender and defeated Cheshi. Made marquis, he later had 300 households deducted for a legal offense, fixing his fief at 790 households

cells.content: 神爵三年四月壬戌封，十一年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a renxu day in the fourth month of Shenjue 3; he died eleven years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a renxu day in the fourth month of Shenjue 3. He died eleven years later

cells.content: 初元元年，侯光嗣，八年，永光三年薨，亡後。
cells.literal: In Chuyuan 1, Marquis Guang succeeded; after eight years, he died in Yongguang 3, leaving no heir
cells.idiomatic: In Chuyuan 1, Marquis Guang inherited the title. Eight years later, he died in Yongguang 3, leaving no heir

cells.content: 居攝元年，侯永以吉曾孫紹封，千戶，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: In Jushe 1, Marquis Yong, as a great-grandson of Zheng Ji, continued the enfeoffment with a fief of 1,000 households. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: In Jushe 1, Yong continued the marquessate as a great-grandson of Zheng Ji, with a fief of 1,000 households. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 慎
cells.literal: Shen
cells.idiomatic: Shen

cells.content: 歸德靖侯先賢撣
cells.literal: Marquis Jing of Guide: Xian Xian Dan
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jing of Guide: Xianxian Dan

cells.content: 以匈奴單于從兄日逐王率眾降，侯，二千二百五十戶。
cells.literal: As a cousin of the Xiongnu Chanyu and the Rizhu King, he led his followers to surrender; made marquis with a fief of 2,250 households
cells.idiomatic: A cousin of the Xiongnu Chanyu and the Rizhu King, he led his followers to surrender and was made marquis with a fief of 2,250 households

cells.content: 四月戊戌封，二十六年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a wuxu day in the fourth month; he died twenty-six years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a wuxu day in the fourth month. He died twenty-six years later

cells.content: 竟寧元年，煬侯富昌嗣，二年薨。
cells.literal: In Jingning 1, Marquis Yang, Fuchang, succeeded; he died two years later
cells.idiomatic: In Jingning 1, Marquis Yang — Fuchang — inherited the title. He died two years later

cells.content: 建始二年，侯諷嗣，五十六年薨。
cells.literal: In Jianshi 2, Marquis Feng succeeded; he died fifty-six years later
cells.idiomatic: In Jianshi 2, Marquis Feng inherited the title. He died fifty-six years later

cells.content: 建武二年，侯襄嗣。
cells.literal: In Jianwu 2, Marquis Xiang succeeded
cells.idiomatic: In Jianwu 2, Marquis Xiang inherited the title

cells.content: 汝南侯霸嗣，永平十四年，有罪免。
cells.literal: Marquis Ba of Runan succeeded; in Yongping 14, he was convicted of a crime and dismissed
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Ba of Runan inherited the title. In Yongping 14, he was convicted and dismissed

cells.content: 信成侯王定
cells.literal: Marquis of Xincheng: Wang Ding
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Xincheng: Wang Ding

cells.content: 以匈奴烏桓屠驀單于子左大將軍率眾降，侯，千六百戶，後坐弟謀反，削百五戶。
cells.literal: As the son of the Xiongnu Wuhuan Tumo Chanyu and Left Grand General, he led his followers to surrender; made marquis with a fief of 1,600 households. He was later convicted on account of his brother's rebellion plot and had 105 households deducted
cells.idiomatic: The son of the Xiongnu Wuhuan Tumo Chanyu and Left Grand General, he led his followers to surrender and was made marquis with a fief of 1,600 households. Later, he had 105 households deducted because of his brother's rebellion plot

cells.content: 五鳳二年九月癸巳封，十二年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a guisi day in the ninth month of Wufeng 2; he died twelve years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a guisi day in the ninth month of Wufeng 2. He died twelve years later

cells.content: 初元五年，侯廣漢嗣，三年，永光三年薨，亡後。
cells.literal: In Chuyuan 5, Marquis Guanghan succeeded; after three years, he died in Yongguang 3, leaving no heir
cells.idiomatic: In Chuyuan 5, Marquis Guanghan inherited the title. Three years later, he died in Yongguang 3, leaving no heir

cells.content: 元始五年，侯楊以定孫紹封，千戶。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 5, Marquis Yang, as a grandson of Wang Ding, continued the enfeoffment with a fief of 1,000 households
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 5, Yang continued the marquessate as a grandson of Wang Ding, with a fief of 1,000 households

cells.content: 細陽
cells.literal: Xiyang
cells.idiomatic: Xiyang

cells.content: 義陽侯厲溫敦
cells.literal: Marquis of Yiyang: Li Wendun
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yiyang: Li Wendun

cells.content: 以匈奴謼連累單于率眾降，侯，千五百戶。
cells.literal: As a Xiongnu Hulian chief under the Chanyu, he led his followers to surrender; made marquis with a fief of 1,500 households
cells.idiomatic: A Xiongnu Hulian chief who led his followers to surrender. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,500 households

cells.content: 三年二月甲子封，四年，坐子伊細王謀反，削爵為關內侯，食邑千戶。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the second month of the third year. After four years, he was convicted because his son, the Yixi King, plotted rebellion; his rank was reduced to Marquis within the Passes with an alimentary fief of 1,000 households
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiazi day in the second month of the third year. Four years later, he was demoted to Marquis within the Passes with a fief of 1,000 households because his son, the Yixi King, plotted rebellion

translations.literal: Above: eleven persons under Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists eleven persons enfeoffed under Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 陽都、營平、平丘、昌水、陽城、爰氏、扶陽、高平、陽城、博陽、邛成、將陵、建成、西平、平恩、平昌、樂陵、平臺、樂昌、博望、樂成二十一人在恩澤外戚，樂平、冠陽、酇、周子南君四人隨父，凡三十六人。

translations.literal: Yangdu, Yingping, Pingqiu, Changshui, Yangcheng, Yuanshi, Fuyang, Gaoping, Yangcheng, Boyang, Qiongcheng, Jiangling, Jiancheng, Xiping, Ping'en, Pingchang, Leling, Pingtai, Lechang, Bowang, and Lecheng — twenty-one persons counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. Leping, Guanyang, Zan, and the Lord of Zhou Zinan — four persons listed with their fathers. In total, thirty-six persons.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one persons — Yangdu, Yingping, Pingqiu, Changshui, Yangcheng, Yuanshi, Fuyang, Gaoping, Yangcheng, Boyang, Qiongcheng, Jiangling, Jiancheng, Xiping, Ping'en, Pingchang, Leling, Pingtai, Lechang, Bowang, and Lecheng — are counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. Four — Leping, Guanyang, Zan, and the Lord of Zhou Zinan — are listed with their fathers. The total is thirty-six persons.

cells.content: 義成侯甘延壽
cells.literal: Marquis of Yicheng: Gan Yanshou
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Yicheng: Gan Yanshou

cells.content: 以使西域騎都尉討郅支單于斬王以下千五百級，侯，四百戶，孫遷益封，凡二千戶。
cells.literal: As Cavalry Commandant on a mission to the Western Regions, he attacked the Zhizhi Chanyu and beheaded the king and 1,500 others below him; made marquis with a fief of 400 households. His grandson Qian received additional enfeoffment, totaling 2,000 households
cells.idiomatic: As Cavalry Commandant on a Western Regions mission, he attacked the Zhizhi Chanyu, beheading the king and 1,500 others. Made marquis with a fief of 400 households, his grandson Qian later received an increase, bringing the total to 2,000 households

cells.content: 竟寧元年四月戊辰封，九年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a Wuchen day in the fourth month of Jingning 1; he died nine years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a Wuchen day in the fourth month of Jingning 1. He died nine years later

cells.content: 陽朔元年，煬侯建嗣，十九年薨。
cells.literal: In Yangshuo 1, Marquis Yang, Jian, succeeded; he died nineteen years later
cells.idiomatic: In Yangshuo 1, Marquis Yang — Jian — inherited the title. He died nineteen years later

cells.content: 建平元年，節侯遷嗣，居攝二年更為誅郅支侯，十四年薨。
cells.literal: In Jianping 1, Marquis Jie, Qian, succeeded. In Jushe 2 his title was changed to Marquis Who Punished the Zhizhi; he died fourteen years later
cells.idiomatic: In Jianping 1, Marquis Jie — Qian — inherited the title. In Jushe 2, his title was renamed 'Marquis Who Punished the Zhizhi.' He died fourteen years later

cells.content: 建國二年，侯相嗣，建武四年，為兵所殺。
cells.literal: In Jianguo 2, Marquis Xiang succeeded. In Jianwu 4, he was killed by soldiers
cells.idiomatic: In Jianguo 2, Marquis Xiang inherited the title. In Jianwu 4, he was killed by soldiers

cells.content: 駟望忠侯冷廣
cells.literal: Marquis Zhong of Siwang: Leng Guang
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Zhong of Siwang: Leng Guang

cells.content: 以濕沃公士告男子馬政謀反，侯，千八百戶。
cells.literal: As a Gongshi of Shiwo, he reported the commoner Ma Zheng for plotting rebellion; made marquis with a fief of 1,800 households
cells.idiomatic: A Gongshi of Shiwo who reported the commoner Ma Zheng for plotting rebellion. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,800 households

cells.content: 鴻嘉元年正月辛丑封，薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a xinchou day in the first month of Hongjia 1; he died
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a xinchou day in the first month of Hongjia 1. He died

cells.content: 侯何齊嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: Marquis He Qi succeeded. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: He Qi inherited the title. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 琅邪
cells.literal: Lang Ye
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Lang Ye

cells.content: 延鄉節侯李譚
cells.literal: Marquis Jie of Yanxiang: Li Tan
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Jie of Yanxiang: Li Tan

cells.content: 以尉氏男子捕得反者樊並侯，千戶。
cells.literal: As a commoner of Weishi, he captured the rebel Fan Bing; made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households
cells.idiomatic: A commoner of Weishi who captured the rebel Fan Bing. He was made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households

cells.content: 永始四年七月己巳封，十三年薨。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jisi day in the seventh month of Yongshi 4; he died thirteen years later
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jisi day in the seventh month of Yongshi 4. He died thirteen years later

cells.content: 元始元年，侯成嗣，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 1, Marquis Cheng succeeded. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 1, Marquis Cheng inherited the title. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 新山侯稱忠
cells.literal: Marquis of Xinshan: Cheng Zhong
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Xinshan: Cheng Zhong

cells.content: 以捕得反者樊並侯，千戶。
cells.literal: He captured the rebel Fan Bing; made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households
cells.idiomatic: He captured the rebel Fan Bing and was made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households

cells.content: 十一月己酉封。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiyou day in the eleventh month
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiyou day in the eleventh month

cells.content: 童鄉釐侯鍾祖
cells.literal: Marquis Xi of Tongxiang: Zhong Zu
cells.idiomatic: Marquis Xi of Tongxiang: Zhong Zu

cells.content: 以捕得反者樊並侯，千戶。
cells.literal: He captured the rebel Fan Bing; made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households
cells.idiomatic: He captured the rebel Fan Bing and was made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households

cells.content: 七月己酉封，薨，亡後。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiyou day in the seventh month; he died and left no heir
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiyou day in the seventh month. He died and left no heir

cells.content: 元始五年，侯匡以祖子紹封，王莽敗，絕。
cells.literal: In Yuanshi 5, Marquis Kuang, as a son of Zhong Zu, continued the enfeoffment. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished
cells.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 5, Kuang continued the marquessate as a son of Zhong Zu. When Wang Mang fell, the line was extinguished

cells.content: 樓虛侯訾順
cells.literal: Marquis of Louxu: Zi Shun
cells.idiomatic: Marquis of Louxu: Zi Shun

cells.content: 以捕得反者樊並侯，千戶。
cells.literal: He captured the rebel Fan Bing; made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households
cells.idiomatic: He captured the rebel Fan Bing and was made marquis with a fief of 1,000 households

cells.content: 七月己酉封。
cells.literal: Enfeoffed on a jiyou day in the seventh month
cells.idiomatic: Enfeoffed on a jiyou day in the seventh month

translations.literal: Above: one person under Emperor Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The above lists one person enfeoffed under Emperor Yuan.

sentences.zh: 安平、平恩、扶陽三人隨父，陽平、樂安二人在恩澤外戚，凡六人。

translations.literal: Anping, Ping'en, and Fuyang — three persons listed with their fathers. Yangping and Le'an — two persons counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. In total, six persons.
translations.idiomatic: Three persons — Anping, Ping'en, and Fuyang — are listed with their fathers. Two — Yangping and Le'an — are counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. The total is six persons.

translations.literal: Emperor Cheng: five persons.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Cheng: five persons were enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 安昌、高陽、安陽、城陽、高陵、定陵、殷紹嘉、宜鄉、氾鄉、博山十人在恩澤外戚，武陽、博陽、贊、騏、龍額、開陵、樂陵、博望、樂成、安平、平阿、成都、紅陽、曲陽、高平十五人隨父，凡三十人。

translations.literal: Anchang, Gaoyang, Anyang, Chengyang, Gaoling, Dingling, Yin Shaojia, Yixiang, Fanxiang, and Boshan — ten persons counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. Wuyang, Boyang, Zan, Qi, Long'e, Kailing, Leling, Bowang, Lecheng, Anping, Ping'a, Chengdu, Hongyang, Quyang, and Gaoping — fifteen persons listed with their fathers. In total, thirty persons.
translations.idiomatic: Ten persons — Anchang, Gaoyang, Anyang, Chengyang, Gaoling, Dingling, Yin Shaojia, Yixiang, Fanxiang, and Boshan — are counted among imperial relatives by marriage and favor. Fifteen — Wuyang, Boyang, Zan, Qi, Long'e, Kailing, Leling, Bowang, Lecheng, Anping, Ping'a, Chengdu, Hongyang, Quyang, and Gaoping — are listed with their fathers. The total is thirty persons.
